carriers.name: HealthSpring
carriers.scope: Former Cigna Medicare · 2027 documents across 15 target states; one NC plan in comparison
carriers.availability: 146 Medicare Advantage state/plan-segment entries checked against CMS and official PDFs across 12 target states. LA, MI and NY have only standalone PDP entries in the reviewed sources. Plan comparison currently includes True Choice H7849-113-001 in its 11 NC counties.
carriers.benefits: 143 unique EOC PDFs collected; searchable library and Excel-compatible plan/segment CSV published. True Choice benefit amounts are imported with conditions; its OTC allowance and annual routine rides remain unverified, not zero. Other plan benefit comparisons are pending. PA H3949-052 website county metadata differs, but its printed EOC and CMS agree.
carriers.medications: Six 2027 shared formularies collected with 15,304 candidate entries. Explicit PDF applicability links 139 MA state/segments; seven have no included Part D. Assurance/Extra standalone PDP lists remain separate. Medication comparison currently uses the NC True Choice formulary and plan-listed tier costs; exact coverage requires review.
carriers.providers: All 38 available regional HMO/PPO directories indexed across the 12 MA target states. Dated PDF suggestions include office details and source pages; extraction is partial. Select the correct regional directory. Only the NC True Choice PPO connection is verified for comparison; other directory-to-plan links and all live network coverage remain unverified. EyeMed locator is linked in results and Excel.
carriers.connection: Public FHIR on port 8003 works without authentication for tested requests. Last inspected catalog contained 618 plans dated 2025/2026; no 2027 mapping found. The connector checks exact plan/segment and full-year dates and rejects historical mappings. PDF suggestions work independently of the live API.
carriers.next_step: Import benefit schedules for additional plan/segments, verify their exact directory connections, and recheck the API for 2027 network records. Confirm True Choice OTC/routine-transportation benefit amounts before using them in ranking.
